subject: How to allow a selcction of multiple items using shift + click

messages.author: f912724b32d84d06
messages.subject: How to allow a selcction of multiple items using shift + click
parts:
Hello!

I am trying to allow the user to select multiple column names:

      #Drop down for user to choose the columns with utilities:

      output$Utilvariables <- renderUI({
            if(is.null(input$datafile)){return()}
            vars <- names(mydata()$df.raw)
            selectInput('Utilvariables', 'Columns with Utilities', choices = vars,
                        multiple = TRUE, selected = vars)
      })

I have multiple = TRUE, and it allows the user to select several, but one still has to click on each and every one of them in order to be selected.
How could I allow the user to select several column names using shift + click?

I am using RStudio Version 0.99.48 and the latest R.

Thank you!

messages.author: f912724b32d84d06
messages.subject: Re: How to allow a selcction of multiple items using shift + click
parts:
It turns out it should be:

multiple = TRUE, selected = vars, selectize = FALSE

Thank you!
